opening.argument: The video examines Tom Lee's bullish Ethereum thesis as a prediction to evaluate, not a transaction to complete. It attributes the $7,000 and $15,000 price targets to him and presents the 100x possibility as something he floats, while asking whether the fundamentals support the thesis or whether it is crypto hype. The description expressly identifies the material as educational and entertainment content, not financial advice. Speculative forecasts can be discussed without becoming a solicitation: the cited material gives no direct instruction to send money, provide data, or use a platform.

citations.quote: Just for ETH to catch up to its old valuation against Bitcoin, he sees a near-term target of $7,000 and his target for the end of the year, a stunning $15,000.
He actually argues the upside for Ethereum is even higher than Bitcoin's ever was and he literally floats the idea of a 100x return.
Is this the opportunity or just more crypto hype?
